scope_notes: Before binaries are the gravity integration pass from docs/data/dirt-gravity-20261008.json.

The measured examples predate the final capture-only profiling guard; the benchmark source manifest and preserved example identify their exact source. Neither matrix nor tick profiles enable capture. The guard is validated separately against profile span counts and frozen snapshot bytes.
Only query-local caches and benchmark capture support change; placement rules, budgets, clearance, repose and physics are unchanged.
One uninstrumented timing run per case/version/host, with before/after paired by workload. Desktop timing overlapped builds, including unrelated workspace work. Pi kiosk stayed paused.
Whole-scenario step timing excludes audits, capture, replay and rendering. The CSV benchmark reports rendering separately.
Frozen reports are byte-identical before/after and cross-host. Their profile includes inspection tracing; actual simulation tick profiles are separate.
Cave actor-omission queries are independent alternatives, not cumulative deposits or proof of optimal packing. Capture bypasses retry timing and inspection enables recovery.
